profile_text.body:
Unisys describes itself as a global technology solutions company serving cloud, AI, digital workplace, applications, and enterprise computing. Its site presents offerings across AI advisory, solution development, and scalable infrastructure, along with cloud migration, modernization, and management across hosts including AWS, Azure, Google, and customer data centers. It also covers application modernization, agentic AI-driven service desk support, field services, and device subscription options.

On AI, the company says it combines strategic advisory, solution development, and infrastructure with change management expertise, and it frames its pitch as turning AI investments into business results. It publishes an AI & Cloud Insights Report 2026 on scaling AI and modernizing securely, and it points to peer-reviewed quantum computing research from its team covering optimization, machine learning, financial services, and precision medicine. CEO Mike Thomson is cited on AI governance and why it cannot wait for policy to catch up. The site notes that some content may be created or assisted by AI and that Unisys does not guarantee all information is free from errors or omissions.

Unisys is a public company traded under the ticker UIS, with SEC CIK 0000746838.
